# Decepticon — Interactive Security Auditor Demos

> Zero-install, offline-safe browser demos of Decepticon's specialist security
> auditors. Every check runs entirely client-side against synthetic inputs —
> no signup, no server, and no data leaves the browser.

Decepticon is an agentic security platform. These demos let you try two
specialist auditors in the browser before installing the full stack. They are
intentionally self-contained (hardened Content-Security-Policy, no network
calls) so they are safe to open from `file://` or over HTTPS.

## Interactive demos

- [GNSS Auditor](https://dnzengou.github.io/evo-decepticon/gnss_auditor_ui.html): Post-quantum GNSS/OSNMA signal audits. Runs three checks client-side — Grover-gap TESLA MAC margin, root-signature quantum readiness (RSA / ECDSA / Dilithium / Falcon), and receiver jam/spoof walk-off versus envelope with and without OSNMA.
- [Crypto HW Auditor](https://dnzengou.github.io/evo-decepticon/wallet_auditor_ui.html): Hardware wallet RNG and firmware forensics, built in response to the 2026 Coldcard incident. Score RNG samples for weak entropy, calculate BIP39 seed strength, and check firmware versions against known-vulnerable ranges.

## Command-line demos

- [GNSS PQC CLI demo](https://github.com/dnzengou/evo-decepticon/blob/main/demo/gnss_pqc_demo.py): Emits three HIGH-severity GNSS findings in under a second, stdlib-only.
- [Wallet RNG CLI demo](https://github.com/dnzengou/evo-decepticon/blob/main/demo/wallet_rng_demo.py): Emits three hardware-wallet RNG findings in under a second, stdlib-only.
